document_metadata.title: 32、INT. MACHINE SHOP - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: The Princess flees through a tunnel maze, evading pursuers, and uses a medallion to find a hidden chamber filled with bookshelves.

entities.name: Prince Nuada returns from exile and kneels before King Balor
entities.description: Prince Nuada enters the abandoned machine shop turned council chamber, bows his head, kneels, and addresses his father, King Balor, marking his formal return from exile.

entities.name: King Balor confronts Prince Nuada about breaking the truce
entities.description: King Balor, visibly angered, questions Prince Nuada on why he has broken a centuries-old truce, expressing disbelief and emotional turmoil over his son's actions.

entities.name: Prince Nuada declares intent to reclaim elven land and freedom
entities.description: Prince Nuada asserts that he has returned to liberate his people, reclaim their ancestral land, and restore the freedom that he believes was unjustly taken from them.

entities.name: Princess Nuala intervenes to defend the truce agreement
entities.description: Princess Nuala steps forward and argues that despite human actions, their people must honor the terms of the agreement they swore to uphold.

entities.name: Prince Nuada denounces the current state of elven existence
entities.description: Prince Nuada passionately criticizes the degraded living conditions of his people, questioning the honor in surviving in human ruins and begging for scraps.

entities.name: King Balor expresses doubt about the future of his people
entities.description: King Balor responds to his son's defiance by suggesting that their time may have come to an end, reflecting a sense of resignation and sorrow.

entities.name: Prince Nuada vows resistance and defiance in the face of extinction
entities.description: Prince Nuada declares that even if their end is near, his people will not fade quietly, proclaiming that it is better to burn with honor than to disappear without a fight.

entities.name: Prince Nuada challenges clan leaders with a call to action
entities.description: After his declaration, Prince Nuada looks each of the clan leaders in the eye, silently challenging them to join his cause and rise against the truce.

entities.name: Council Meeting Of The Magick Families
entities.description: A formal gathering of high-ranking leaders from various Magick Families—goblins, trolls, dwarves, and elves—convened in an abandoned machine shop to discuss matters of truce, honor, and the future of their people.
entities.summary: A formal gathering of high-ranking leaders from various Magick Families—goblins, trolls, dwarves, and elves—convened in an abandoned machine shop to discuss matters of truce, honor, and the future of their people.

entities.name: abandoned machine shop
entities.description: A repurposed industrial space serving as the council chamber for the Magick Families' meeting.

entities.name: King Balor
entities.description: The One-armed King of Elfland, ruler of the elves, who presides over the council and confronts his son about breaking the truce.
entities.summary: The one-armed King of Elfland rules the elves, commands goblins and the Sigri, leads the Golden Army, and confronts his son over breaking the truce while battling human forces.

entities.name: Princess Nuala
entities.description: The willowy and beautiful sister of Prince Nuada, who defends the truce agreement and bears a strong resemblance to her brother.
entities.summary: Prince Nuada's willowy, beautiful twin sister, dressed in fine silk, defends the truce and Hellboy's challenge, shares a glance with Abe, and takes him captive while seeking diplomatic asylum.

entities.name: Prince Nuada
entities.description: A defiant elven prince who returns from exile to challenge the truce and call for reclaiming elven land and freedom.
entities.summary: An elven prince, son of King Balor and brother to the princess, returns from exile to oppose the human-elf truce, reclaim elven lands, command mechanical forces, and challenge leadership, notably confronting Hellboy.

entities.name: Magick Families
entities.description: A collective of high-ranking supernatural clans including goblins, trolls, dwarves, and elves who gather in council.
entities.summary: A collective of high-ranking supernatural clans including goblins, trolls, dwarves, and elves who gather in council.

entities.name: Golden Pendant
entities.description: A large golden piece worn on a chain by both King Balor and Princess Nuala, symbolizing their royal status and connection.
entities.summary: A large golden piece worn on a chain by both King Balor and Princess Nuala, symbolizing their royal status and connection.

entities.name: Prince Nuada reveals the golden artifact and declares alliance with all factions
entities.description: Prince Nuada presents the golden artifact from the auction, declaring that he will enlist the help of the Good, the Bad, and the Worst to support his cause, provoking shock from the crowd.

entities.name: King Balor recognizes the artifact and warns Prince Nuada of the consequences
entities.description: King Balor reacts to the artifact by covering his matching medallion and confronts Prince Nuada, questioning his sanity and the path he has chosen, aware of the dire implications.

entities.name: Prince Nuada confirms his defiance and accepts the consequences
entities.description: Prince Nuada affirms his decision to proceed with his plan, directly responding to his father's warning with grim determination, signaling his full break from the throne.

entities.name: King Balor orders Prince Nuada's execution
entities.description: After a moment of sorrow, King Balor gives the command to his Praetorian Guards to execute Prince Nuada, declaring he has no other choice.

entities.name: Praetorian Guards assassinate King Balor on Prince Nuada's command
entities.description: The Praetorian Guards, now loyal to Prince Nuada, turn on King Balor and stab him to death, fulfilling Prince Nuada's implied coup and leaving the monarch dead on his throne.

entities.name: Princess Nuala witnesses the assassination of King Balor
entities.description: Princess Nuala screams in horror as she watches her father, King Balor, being murdered by the Praetorian Guards under Prince Nuada's direction.

entities.name: Prince Nuada seizes the royal medallion from King Balor's corpse
entities.description: After the assassination, Prince Nuada approaches his father's body and forcibly takes the matching medallion from around his neck, claiming it as part of his inheritance.

entities.name: Prince Nuada threatens clan leaders with forced allegiance or death
entities.description: Prince Nuada addresses the terrified clan leaders, giving them an ultimatum to join his cause or be killed immediately, asserting his dominance over the elven leadership.

entities.name: Prince Nuada fuses the golden artifact and medallion into a nearly complete crown
entities.description: Using a display of magical nanotechnology, Prince Nuada joins the two golden pieces together, forming a nearly complete crown that symbolizes his claim to power.

entities.name: Praetorian Guards
entities.description: Elite guards serving King Balor who carry out Prince Nuada's command to assassinate the king and later protect Prince Nuada during his declaration of power.
entities.summary:
Elite guards serving King Balor who carry out Prince Nuada's command to assassinate the king and later protect Prince Nuada during his declaration of power.
Elite guards accompanying the Prince during his escape through the tunnel, addressed by him in a moment of pain and frustration.

entities.name: Crown
entities.description: A nearly complete magical crown formed by fusing the golden artifact and the royal medallion, symbolizing Prince Nuada's claim to elven sovereignty and leadership.
entities.summary: A magical golden crown, forged from the fusion of a golden artifact and royal medallion, symbolizes elven sovereignty, commands the golden army, and is central to Prince Nuada's claim, whose destruction collapses the army.

entities.description: Heads of elven noble families who are present at the council and confronted by Prince Nuada regarding allegiance to his cause.

document_metadata.title: 120、INT. CAVERN
document_metadata.summary: Hellboy destroys the crown, disbanding the golden army; he warns the troll guards to stay in the shadows as the siblings' ashes blow away, left troubled by the Prince's final words.

entities.name: Hellboy interacts with a golden soldier statue
entities.description: Hellboy taps on a mechanical soldier's chest, causing a faint boom and echo in the cavern, which eventually leads to the soldier toppling over.

entities.name: Chain reaction of falling golden soldiers
entities.description: After one mechanical soldier falls, it triggers a domino effect, causing a line of soldiers to crash down one after another, creating a loud, destructive noise.

entities.name: Hellboy narrowly avoids collapsing soldiers
entities.description: As a second wave of mechanical soldiers falls toward them, Hellboy pulls Liz aside to safety just before the crashing line stops.

entities.name: The Prince reveals himself after the chaos
entities.description: Following the collapse of the soldiers, the Prince is revealed at the head of the column, addressing Hellboy and the others.

entities.name: The Prince confronts Hellboy about his injury
entities.description: The Prince notes that Hellboy is bleeding, calling it unfortunate, while Hellboy responds defiantly, threatening retaliation.

entities.name: The Prince displays command over the soldiers
entities.description: The Prince walks among the golden soldiers, kicks aside some weapons, and declares them patient and awaiting orders from their lawful commander.

entities.name: The Prince assembles gold control segments
entities.description: The Prince produces two gold segments from his tunic and fits them together, indicating he holds part of a key mechanism for controlling the soldiers.

entities.name: The Prince demands the final gold segment
entities.description: After assembling his pieces, the Prince states that Hellboy must possess the remaining piece of the control mechanism.

entities.name: Confrontation In The Underground Arena
entities.description: A tense encounter unfolds in a vast subterranean chamber filled with golden soldiers, where Hellboy and his team face the Prince amidst mechanical ruins and rising danger.
entities.summary: A tense encounter unfolds in a vast subterranean chamber filled with golden soldiers, where Hellboy and his team face the Prince amidst mechanical ruins and rising danger.

entities.name: underground arena
entities.description: A vast subterranean chamber filled with golden soldier statues, serving as the setting for the confrontation between Hellboy and the Prince.

entities.name: Hellboy
entities.description: A powerful, anthropomorphic demon who leads the group through the underground arena and interacts with the golden soldiers.
entities.summary: A team of supernatural beings and operatives, including a red stone-like entity, a demon-like figure, and a paranormal agent, prepares for a mission involving paranormal events, destruction, and retrieval of damaged media, while ensuring discretion and handling personal quirks like a preference for 8-track tapes.

entities.name: Johann
entities.description: A member of the team exploring the underground arena who examines the design and function of the golden soldiers.
entities.summary: A team member involved in surveillance with Hellboy and Abe, who follows the Bag Lady, declines beer, presents a royal seal drawing to a shop owner, and expresses fear of the unstoppable Golden Army during a prayer-like speech on defense and belonging.

entities.name: Liz
entities.description: A member of the team who reacts to the chaos caused by the falling golden soldiers and is pulled to safety by Hellboy.
entities.summary: A team member with a supernatural blue flame aura confronts Hellboy about his music and skepticism, arms herself silently, and presses Abe for truths amid strange phenomena, showing tension and determination.

entities.name: The Prince
entities.description: A mysterious figure who reveals himself after the collapse of the golden soldiers and claims authority over them.
entities.summary: A character without a gold crown leads a non-threatening army, guides the Princess through danger, and reveals himself as the authority over golden soldiers after their collapse.

entities.name: Golden Soldier
entities.description: A mechanical, humanoid statue armed with lethal weaponry, arranged in ranks within the underground arena.
entities.summary: A mechanical, humanoid statue armed with lethal weaponry, arranged in ranks within the underground arena.

entities.name: Gold Segment
entities.description: A small, golden component that fits together with others, apparently part of a control mechanism for the golden soldiers.
entities.summary: A small, golden component that fits together with others, apparently part of a control mechanism for the golden soldiers.

entities.name: lawful commander
entities.description: A title or role claimed by The Prince, indicating legitimate authority over the golden soldiers.

entities.name: The Prince receives the final gold segment from Abe
entities.description: Abe, having retrieved the last gold segment, hands it over to the Prince in exchange for the Princess's freedom, fulfilling the Prince's demand under the belief of a negotiated ransom.

entities.name: Abe confronts the Prince about the broken ransom agreement
entities.description: Abe, horrified by the Prince's actions, directly challenges him, stating that the gold segment was given in good faith as part of a ransom agreement to free the Princess.

entities.name: Hellboy expresses betrayal and distrust toward Abe
entities.description: Hellboy, feeling deceived and emotionally conflicted, confronts Abe, indicating a breakdown in trust and foreshadowing a necessary conversation if they survive the encounter.

entities.name: The Prince completes and wears the golden crown
entities.description: The Prince assembles the final gold segment with the existing pieces, forming a complete crown, which he places on his head, symbolizing his claim to authority and activating his command over the golden soldiers.

entities.name: The Prince declares his identity and commands the army to awaken
entities.description: The Prince announces himself as Prince Nuada and asserts his royal authority, demanding recognition and ordering the golden army to activate, which they do through mechanical animation.

entities.name: The Prince orders the golden army to kill the team
entities.description: After confirming his authority, the Prince points at Hellboy, Johann, and the others, issuing a direct command for the reactivated golden army to eliminate them.

entities.name: Troll guards bring the Princess out in chains
entities.description: On the Prince's signal, troll guards escort the Princess from a tunnel entrance, holding her captive in chains, demonstrating the Prince's control over both his sister and his forces.

entities.name: tunnel entrance
entities.description: A specific entry point in the underground arena where Abe appears and delivers the final gold segment.

entities.name: Abe Sapien
entities.description: A character who retrieves the final gold segment to ransom the Princess and confronts the Prince about the broken agreement, expressing shock at the betrayal.
entities.summary: A BPRD team member with webbed fingers assists Hellboy and Liz, detects unseen creatures, warns of underground threats, and communicates via intercom during an investigation at a dark sales room and auction site.

entities.name: Princess Nuala
entities.description: The sister of the Prince, brought out in chains by troll guards and used as leverage in the exchange for the final gold segment.
entities.summary: A royal figure, possibly the Prince's sister, flees through tunnels, retrieves an ancient tome, and escapes attacks by trolls, later disguising herself in the Troll Market where Abe recognizes her by her bracelet and follows her into dark alleys.

entities.name: troll guard
entities.description: Guards serving the Prince who bring the Princess out in chains from the tunnel entrance.

entities.name: Crown
entities.description: The completed crown formed by assembling all gold segments, which the Prince wears to activate the golden army.
entities.summary: The completed crown formed by assembling all gold segments, which the Prince wears to activate the golden army.

entities.name: Army advances on the group with coordinated attack
entities.description: The golden mechanical soldiers march toward the BPRD team in a unified phalanx, launching a synchronized assault with their weapons.

entities.name: Hellboy draws his large firearm and opens fire
entities.description: Hellboy pulls out his massive gun and begins shooting at the approaching mechanical soldiers, temporarily taking down several units.

entities.name: Johann seizes a torch and attacks with it as a weapon
entities.description: Johann grabs a torch and swings it like a club against the advancing mechanical soldiers, engaging in close combat.

entities.name: Liz generates and releases explosive electrical fire
entities.description: Liz conjures intense bursts of electrical fire in her hands and unleashes a powerful explosion that knocks down numerous mechanical soldiers.

entities.name: Mechanical soldiers regenerate and adapt with new weapons
entities.description: After being knocked down, several mechanical soldiers reactivate with newly emerged weapons on their arms, continuing the assault.

entities.name: Hellboy charges into combat despite severe injury
entities.description: Hellboy holsters his gun and rushes forward to fight the mechanical soldiers bare-handed, enduring repeated blows that worsen his wounds.

entities.name: Mechanical soldiers overpower and throw Hellboy against the wall
entities.description: The mechanical soldiers overwhelm Hellboy, using their arms to hurl him violently into a wall, causing him to collapse unconscious.

entities.name: Johann projects his ectoplasmic form into a mechanical soldier
entities.description: Johann exits his containment suit and possesses a nearby mechanical soldier, turning it against its own kind.

entities.name: Possessed mechanical soldier attacks enemy ranks
entities.description: Under Johann's control, the mechanical soldier turns on its companions, violently dismantling multiple units in rapid succession.

entities.name: Enemy soldiers destroy Johann's possessed unit
entities.description: The remaining mechanical soldiers surround and systematically dismantle the unit controlled by Johann, rendering it inoperative.

entities.name: Johann retreats and re-enters his containment suit
entities.description: After his host unit is destroyed, Johann's ectoplasmic form escapes and returns to his original suit.

entities.name: Hellboy retrieves a sword and rises to continue fighting
entities.description: Despite his injuries, Hellboy grabs a nearby sword and pulls himself back to his feet, preparing to rejoin the battle.

entities.name: Hellboy challenges Prince Nuada's authority to command the army
entities.description: Hellboy loudly declares a formal challenge to Prince Nuada's right to lead the mechanical army, causing the clockwork soldiers to halt their actions and turn their attention toward the confrontation.

entities.name: Clockwork troops stop advancing in response to Hellboy's challenge
entities.description: Upon Hellboy's declaration of challenge, the mechanical soldiers abruptly cease their movements with a soft boom, turning their heads toward Prince Nuada and awaiting the outcome of the ritual combat.

entities.name: Princess Nuala defends Hellboy's right to issue a challenge
entities.description: Princess Nuala intervenes by declaring Hellboy's true identity as Anung-un-Rama of the Fallen One, affirming his legitimacy to issue a formal challenge under the ancient rules.

entities.name: Prince Nuada accepts Hellboy's challenge and draws his sword
entities.description: After a moment of scornful hesitation, Prince Nuada picks up his sword with a bitter smile, formally accepting Hellboy's challenge and preparing for one-on-one combat.

entities.name: Hellboy and Prince Nuada begin sword combat in the arena
entities.description: The clash between Hellboy and Prince Nuada commences, with the sound of their swords ringing through the hall as they fight under the watchful presence of the golden army.

entities.name: Hellboy struggles physically during combat with Prince Nuada
entities.description: Despite summoning his last strength, Hellboy falters in battle, his sword trembling in his hands as his body fails him, leaving him vulnerable to the Prince's attacks.

entities.name: Abe silently pleads with Hellboy during the duel
entities.description: As Hellboy gains opportunities to strike, Abe repeatedly looks at him with desperate, pleading eyes, communicating a hidden request that prevents Hellboy from landing a decisive blow.

entities.name: Liz reacts in horror to Hellboy's impending defeat
entities.description: Witnessing the dire turn of the battle, Liz cries out in anguish and disbelief, realizing that Hellboy is on the verge of being killed by Prince Nuada.
